summary: The study demonstrates the template-free vapor-phase growth of VS4 thin films using atomic layer deposition (ALD) with tris(N,N'-diisopropylacetamidinate) vanadium(III) (V(amd)3) and H2S precursors. The process enables the synthesis of phase-pure VS4 films with controlled stoichiometry and crystallinity. The ALD process exhibits self-limiting surface chemistry, with a growth rate of 0.33 Å/cycle and low roughness (2.4 nm). The study also identifies a temperature-dependent surface mechanism that leads to the formation of a second vanadium-sulfur phase, V2S3, at elevated temperatures.
